card.name: Inside German compounds and split numbers
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a long German compound noun (Chromosomenpaare, Stadtviertel, Erbsenpflanzen, Zeitungsbestände). Also fires on a digit partway through a number, or the start of an acronym such as MAOIs.

modes.label: German compound nouns
modes.description: A middle piece inside a long German noun in an English text.

modes.label: Partway through numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a dose or range, where more digits follow.

modes.label: Start of an acronym
modes.description: The first piece of a bracketed acronym after its spelled-out name.
modes.example: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (<<MA>>OIs) Clinical Impact: MAOI

card.writes: It promotes word-continuing pieces and suppresses plural nouns such as files and tables, so it favors finishing the current word.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long word or number, such as a German compound or a dose figure, where the item is not yet finished.
